## Research

**Current focus.** Spatially resolved dust extinction in the 30 Doradus region
of the Large Magellanic Cloud, using Balmer decrements measured from Local
Volume Mapper integral field spectroscopy.

**Areas.**

- Spectral line analysis and Balmer decrements
- Dust extinction mapping in the Large Magellanic Cloud
- Integral field spectroscopy data pipelines
- Extracting physical parameters from large spectroscopic data sets

See [Research](research/index.qmd) for project write-ups and code documentation.
